say:1:1122119001:1.text: Ha, a lowlife like Silverbeak still managed to find lackeys? You guys must be idiots, falling for his act!
say:1:1122119001:1.source_cn: 哈，像银喙这种自私自利的混蛋，居然还能招到小弟？你们是...

say:2:1122119002:1.text: Y-you... You're the dumb one! I, Grayhorn, am the sharpest fork in the drawer!
say:2:1122119002:1.source_cn: 你……你才笨！我告诉你，我老憨可是最精明的！

say:3:1122119003:1.text: What does that even mean...? Never mind, I can't get into the mind of fools. How did someone like you even become a bounty hunter? Did Silverbeak con you into it?
say:3:1122119003:1.source_cn: 就你这种货色，怎么当上赏金猎人的？别是银喙把你坑来的吧。

say:4:1122119004:1.text: He's pulled plenty of dirty tricks like that in the past. Betraying partners, selling secrets, stealing loot... What do you see in him?
say:4:1122119004:1.source_cn: 他过去可是做了不少烂事，背叛同伴、出卖情报、侵吞财宝…...

say:6:1122119005:1.text: Lies! I've worked with him for a while now, and I've never seen him do anything like that!
say:6:1122119005:1.source_cn: 胡扯！我和银喙搭档的时间也不短了，从来没见他做过这种事！

say:7:1122119006:1.text: Well, consider yourself lucky you're still useful. Otherwise, he'd have fed you to an ironjaw ages ago.
say:7:1122119006:1.source_cn: 庆幸吧，你的利用价值还不够，不然早就被他丢去喂钢颚兽了。

say:9:1122119007:1.text: Magister... This guy's begging for a fight! Chippy can barely hold back!
say:9:1122119007:1.source_cn: 主人……这个人说话好欠打啊！！满满要忍不住了！！
say:9:1122119007:1.male: Magister... This guy's begging for a fight! Chippy can barely hold back!
say:9:1122119007:1.female: Magister... This guy's begging for a fight! Chippy can barely hold back!

choice_prompt:10:1122119007.text: Magister... This guy's begging for a fight! Chippy can barely hold back!
choice_prompt:10:1122119007.source_cn: 主人……这个人说话好欠打啊！！满满要忍不住了！！
choice_prompt:10:1122119007.male: Magister... This guy's begging for a fight! Chippy can barely hold back!
choice_prompt:10:1122119007.female: Magister... This guy's begging for a fight! Chippy can barely hold back!

say:11:1122119008:1.text: Ha, I didn't expect there would be someone here with common sense.
say:11:1122119008:1.source_cn: 哈，没想到，这还有个明事理的家伙嘛。
say:11:1122119008:1.male: Ha, I didn't expect there would be someone here with common sense.
say:11:1122119008:1.female: Ha, I didn't expect there would be someone here with common sense.

say:12:1122119009:1.text: Let me tell you all about his past...
say:12:1122119009:1.source_cn: 那就让我来聊聊他过去的龌龊事吧……

say:14:1122119011:1.text: Look who finally showed up. I almost thought you chickened out and ran away.
say:14:1122119011:1.source_cn: 哟，终于出现了。我差点以为你害怕得带着包袱逃跑了呢。

say:15:1122119012:1.text: Albert, what are you doing? Ya need money or something? Or are you looking for another beating?
say:15:1122119012:1.source_cn: 艾伯特，你又来闹事干什么！要钱？还是想让我再揍你一顿？

say:16:1122119013:1.text: Why so aggressive? I'm obviously here to collect that debt. Don't be so uptight.
say:16:1122119013:1.source_cn: 上门讨债这么平常的事，别说得那么功利，我的好兄弟。

say:17:1122119014:1.text: And don't forget how you got a cut of the bounty in the first place!
say:17:1122119014:1.source_cn: 也别忘了，当初你是怎么拿到悬赏分成的。

say:18:1122119015:1.text: ... Fine, I'll give you the money. Take it and leave, and stop causing trouble on my turf!
say:18:1122119015:1.source_cn: ……钱，可以给你。但你拿了就滚，少来我的地盘撒野！

say:19:1122119016:1.text: Remember, this settles your debt with me.

narration:21:1122119017:1.text: Albert takes the money pouch Silverbeak tosses at him and swaggers away.

say:23:1122119018:1.text: Silverbeak, what was that?! Why'd you give that sand-eater money after he was just bad-mouthing you?
say:23:1122119018:1.source_cn: 银喙！你为什么要给那个混蛋钱？！他刚才明明就是在污蔑你！

say:24:1122119019:1.text: It's between him and me, stay out of it.
say:24:1122119019:1.source_cn: 我和他之间的恩怨，不关你的事，你少管。

say:28:1122119021:1.text: Very nice. With this money, we can continue building up this base.
say:28:1122119021:1.source_cn: 很好，有了这笔钱，基地的建设就可以提上日程了。

say:29:1122119022:1.text: The first forty percent will be used for base construction, and the remaining sixty percent will be divided based on contributions. This'll be the standard for every bounty from now on.
say:29:1122119022:1.source_cn: 先拿四成出来，用于基地建设，其余的六成再按贡献分配——...

say:31:1122119023:1.text: Forty?! Isn't that a bit much? Chippy's starting to believe what that guy said earlier!
say:31:1122119023:1.source_cn: 四成？！你、你这是不是收得太多了？！满满现在有点相信，...

say:32:1122119024:1.text: This is just a temporary measure! By building the base quickly, we can attract more bounty hunters to join us.
say:32:1122119024:1.source_cn: 这是权宜之计！\n只有尽快建设基地，才会有更多赏金猎人...

say:33:1122119025:1.text: And then we can take on bigger jobs and earn even bigger rewards!
say:33:1122119025:1.source_cn: 到时候，我们才能接更大的委托，赚取更多酬金。

choice_prompt:34:1122119025.text: And then we can take on bigger jobs and earn even bigger rewards!
choice_prompt:34:1122119025.source_cn: 到时候，我们才能接更大的委托，赚取更多酬金。

say:35:1122119027:1.text: Look, most bounty hunters are used to working alone. But when they run into a challenge, they often have nowhere to turn and they're just left standing there blankly. I don't want to risk that anymore.
say:35:1122119027:1.source_cn: 赏金猎人大多习惯独自行动，虽然来去潇洒，可一旦遇到困难...

say:36:1122119028:1.text: Once our base is bigger, maybe we can change things and create a big bounty hunters association.
say:36:1122119028:1.source_cn: 等我们的基地建设起来，也许就能改变现状，让赏金猎人也变...

say:37:1122119029:1.text: And as for funding the base... It's up to you to earn the money needed through bounties!
say:37:1122119029:1.source_cn: 至于建设基地的资金——就指望你们做委托挣来了。

say:38:1122119030:1.text: Seriously?! It all comes down to how much the magister gets from bounties in the end anyway...
say:38:1122119030:1.source_cn: 什么嘛！说来说去还是在算计主人拿到的酬金啊！
say:38:1122119030:1.male: Seriously?! It all comes down to how much the magister gets from bounties in the end anyway...
say:38:1122119030:1.female: Seriously?! It all comes down to how much the magister gets from bounties in the end anyway...

choice:34:0:1.source_cn: 没想到你还挺有计划的

say:40:1122119026:1.text: Pah! I'm not the type to go around borrowing and owing debts everywhere!
say:40:1122119026:1.source_cn: ……呸！我可不是到处赊账欠债的人！

choice:34:1:2.source_cn: 你想赚钱不会是为了还债吧……

choice:27:1:2.text: How are we gonna split it?
choice:27:1:2.male: How are we gonna split it?
choice:27:1:2.female: How are we gonna split it?

choice:10:0:1.source_cn: 他这样说一定有他的理由
